node.statement: Using the local partition from 1.4.3.3.1, a_j^+>=0 and H_j>=0 give sum_{j notin G}a_j^+H_j=sum_{j in B}a_j^+H_j+sum_{j in Z}a_j^+H_j. The Z term is zero because H_j=0 on Z, and on B each H_j<=tau/4, so the B term is at most (tau/4) sum_{j in B}a_j^+. Substituting sum_{j in B}a_j^+=sigma-sigma_g from 1.4.3.3.1 yields sum_{j notin G}a_j^+H_j <= (sigma-sigma_g)*tau/4.
